incident-bot: [ALERT] us-west ingress: spike in 503/504 and elevated p99 starting 09:10 UTC. Preliminary impact ~1-2% of hosted requests. Suspected host-level conntrack/BPF map exhaustion. Mitigation underway: steer traffic, apply temporary edge rate-limits. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2367002468

sam.ops: seeing sudden growth in ESTABLISHED flows on ingress hosts; kernel conntrack table near capacity, drops increasing.

priya.eng: confirmed on host-42/43: conntrack_count at ~95% of nf_conntrack_max, kube-proxy BPF maps showing churn after the recent egress mesh rollout. kernel drop counters align.

sam.ops: commencing conntrack flush + sysctl bump (net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max) on affected hosts at 09:18 UTC. enabling conntrack offload for BPF where available.

deploy-bot: Action recorded: sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max increased on host-42 and host-43 by sam.ops @ 09:19 UTC.

tom.support: drafting customer blurb: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx errors in US-WEST caused by infrastructure connection table saturation. Mitigation in progress." Will publish to #customer-updates after QA.

priya.eng: after flush and bump + edge rate-limit, error rate trending down to ~0.4% at 09:28 UTC. monitoring p95/p99 and BPF map churn.

ana-fyi: (quick note) some sidecars reconnected slower; observed brief duplicate connections as backpressure cleared.

ana-fyi is internal note — replace with ana.pm message

ana-fyi: ignore this placeholder

ana-fyi: sorry removing placeholder

ana.pm: ETA to full recovery? execs asking for timeline.

sam.ops: estimate 10-20 minutes for steady-state while in-flight connections drain and caches rewarm. will confirm when errors <0.25% for 5m.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Error rate returned to baseline (~0.15%) at 09:45 UTC. Mitigation summary: increased conntrack limits, flushed conntrack on affected hosts, tuned service-mesh egress map sizing, and applied temporary edge rate-limits. No customer data loss. Postmortem scheduled 2026-03-27 13:00 UTC in #incidents-postmortems. Runbook used: https://status.redwood.ai/runbooks/conntrack-saturation

tom.support: customer note posted and pinned in #customer-updates; outreach to impacted accounts started.

ana.pm: thanks everyone. please drop timeline, metrics, and recommended long-term fixes (map resizing + mesh config change) into the postmortem doc. Owners: sam.ops (ops timeline), priya.eng (root cause + fix), tom.support (customer comms). :white_check_mark:
